title: Free-Energy Asymptotics of the Two-Dimensional Quantum Heisenberg Ferromagnet
summary: We prove the leading low-temperature free-energy asymptotics of the nearest-neighbour quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet on $\mathbb Z^2$. For every fixed $S\in\{\frac12,1,\frac32,\ldots\}$, the free energy per site satisfies \[ \lim_{β\to\infty}β^2S f_2(β,S)=-\fracπ{24}. \] This formula was predicted by Takahashi's modified spin-wave theory [15]. Napiórkowski and Seiringer proved the corresponding upper bound but left the matching lower bound in two dimensions open [13], a gap later highlighted again by Seiringer [14].
